lines.trans: All of you are top-tier vocal stars now — getting everyone together once is so hard because you're all so popular.
I invited you all tonight because I have something fun to propose.
Twelve Singers is revamping its format, and they invited me to compete.
Going by myself would be boring — want to join in together and have one more round just like our contest nine years ago?
I know none of you were convinced inside when I won the championship back then — dare to battle me again?
Without a little gossip like that, could you even call it show business?
Come on, cheers! Twelve Singers, let's go!
Nine years ago, the famed singing competition Voice of Dreams forged pop music's legendary Golden Class.
Now word has broken that five powerhouse vocalists of the Golden Class led by Xin Huimei are joining Twelve Singers together.
Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.
Finish writing your articles before sleeping, alright? Keep pushing, everyone!
Flood every channel with today's story and push it across the entire web!
